description_en: Lists environments that match the specified criteria
description_zh: 批量查询满足条件的环境
kebab_example: aliyun devs list-environments --project-name demo-project --label-selector branch=main --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --keyword dev --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEnvironments

parameters.help_en: Selectors used to filter environments by their `labels`. Only environments that match all selectors are returned. The selectors are combined by using AND logic
parameters.help_zh: 利用实体的labels字段进行筛选。精确匹配labelSelector数组中的所有条件，不同条件之间是“且”的关系
parameters.name: label_selector

parameters.help_en: The page number to retrieve, starting from 1. Defaults to 1 if not specified
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码，默认为1。页码从1开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Defaults to 100. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小，默认为100。取值范围1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword for a case-insensitive fuzzy search on the `name` field of the entity
parameters.help_zh: 模糊搜索关键词。仅支持实体的name字段，且大小写不敏感
parameters.name: keyword
